title: nan
authors: Ji C.; Guo X.; Tang Y.; Han X.; Song Y.
key_contribution: Presents a distributed group covariance compensation adaptive Kalman filter for multi-UAV cooperative localization in pseudolite-augmented GNSS-denied regions, validated on a large semi-physical testbed.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
